traceability.notes:
Story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG is fully implemented and covered by tests. The plugin exposes ESLint v9 flat-config presets (recommended and strict) as arrays intended to be spread after a plugin-registration object, and these presets enable the six core traceability rules with documented severities. Integration with ESLint v9 flat config is verified end-to-end using FlatESLint in tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts.
Rule-level configuration options are defined and enforced via JSON Schema for require-story-annotation and valid-story-reference, and valid-annotation-format uses a dedicated options helper that validates regex-based options, accumulates clear error messages, and falls back to safe defaults. This satisfies both the requirement for configurable rule options and the acceptance criterion for graceful error handling of invalid configuration options.
Documentation in README.md and the user-docs suite (eslint-9-setup-guide.md, examples.md, migration-guide.md) provides clear, concrete configuration examples for JavaScript, TypeScript, mixed projects, and monorepos using ESLint v9 flat config and the plugin’s presets. Combined with the passing Jest suites specifically tied to this story, this provides strong evidence that all acceptance criteria—including presets, ESLint v9 best practices, integration, user experience, configuration error handling, and documentation—are met.
